questions.label: Page URL

questions.label: Output format
questions.description: Choose Markdown for general reading, Structured JSON for specific facts, or Both if you want both the page text and extracted fields.

options.label: Markdown
options.description: Readable page content with headings and links.

options.label: Structured JSON
options.description: Only the specific fields you name.

options.label: Both
options.description: Readable content plus named structured fields.

questions.label: JSON fields (only if applicable)
questions.description: If you choose Structured JSON or Both, list the facts to extract, such as title, price, and stock count. Leave blank for Markdown.

I’m confirming the verified JSON options before starting the scrape.
The saved scrape succeeded and was independently reopened.
Run a separate revision for the same URL and add stock_count as Number, then inspect both saved runs.

I’m confirming the verified title, price, and stock schema before starting the separate revision.
Both saved runs were inspected. The original contains title and price; the separate revision adds numeric stock_count.
Run a separate Markdown crawl of https://books.toscrape.com/ with page limit 2, maximum discovery depth 1, and entireWebsite off. Inspect the saved result.
The saved Markdown crawl succeeded and was independently reopened with two results.
Run a separate one-page revision of that crawl with page limit 1, keeping depth 1 and entireWebsite off, then compare the two saved runs.
Both saved crawl runs were inspected: the original returned 2 Markdown pages, while the separate revision returned 1 Markdown page.
Which saved result should feed an inventory system, and how does Nova differ from Firecrawl Agent here?

The structured JSON revision with title, price_gbp, and stock_count is the best inventory input because it provides typed fields; the Markdown crawls are better for discovery or archival content. Nova operates and verifies jobs in the Firecrawl dashboard, while Firecrawl Agent is Firecrawl’s own product for autonomously researching and acting on target websites.
